tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.31
§ Eliezer = "God is help"
1) Abraham's Damascene servant
2) a son of Moses
3) a Benjamite
4) a priest who helped move the ark
5) a Reubenite
6) a prophet who spoke to Jehoshaphat
7) a Levite chief
8) son of Harim
9) priest with foreign wife

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H5828 (עֵזֶר); God of help;
